description: The attribute vocabulary. With no filter: an index — per component type, the attribute groups and attribute names (cheap; start here). Pass component_type for that type's rules (data type, unit, default, required, input vs result, timeseries allowed), optionally narrowed by group_name. Use get_validation_rule for one attribute in full.

group_name.description: Only rules in this group (group names come from the index).

names_only.description: With component_type: return attribute names only.

name: list_validation_rules
